## Definition of done
- [ ] Code works and I tested it (automated and/or the relevant manual cases in `docs/engineering/testing.md`)
- [ ] Docs updated for this change (see the "update triggers" table in `docs/meta/documentation-system.md`)
- [ ] `Last reviewed` date bumped on every page I touched
- [ ] `docs/project/changelog.md` has an entry under **Unreleased**
- [ ] Architecture-level change? Added or superseded a record in `docs/decisions/`
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, proxy URLs or API keys in the diff (including screenshots and logs)
- [ ] UI change? Screenshot attached
